_why_this_file_exists: A value written as a bare `protein_mg` column instead of nutrient_ref + amount + unit. This is the single most common way a food table loses its meaning: the nutrient identity and the unit are welded into a column NAME, where nothing can resolve them and no two tables agree. FDP-1 §2 requires seven fields on every value; this declaration supplies none of the three that matter. It MUST be rejected.
